meta.parties: Murugappa Chetty v. Samarasekara Et Al

rules.statement: The District Court should have investigated the claimant's application under sections 241 and 242 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: Held, that it was not competent to the District Court to refer the claimant to a separate action, but that her claim was one to be investigated and determined under sections 241 and 242.
